annotations.title: EPC for a property, or an area's EPC band mix

description:
Give exactly one of `uprn` or `area`. For a UPRN: its EPC (current and
    potential rating, fabric, heating, retrofit gap) newest first. For an area
    (postcode district or local authority): the EPC band mix and fuel mix of the
    certificated stock.

    Percentages are of properties that HOLD an EPC (lodged on sale or let), not
    of all stock; say so. An EPC is a survey of the dwelling, not a value and
    not a cost. With an area, `include=["retrofit_candidates"]` adds up to 25
    properties in `bands` (default E, F, G) ranked by improvement headroom; that
    list costs 30 credits, charged only when it returns rows; the rest is free.
    Do NOT use it to estimate a value or an installation cost.
    Free.

    The UPRN answer carries `identity` (unit | building | street | unresolved).
    UK only. Limits: 10 certificates, 25 candidates, 8 KB. Free text is refused: resolve_place first.
    A call with covered=false or an upstream failure is not charged. Keyed on a UPRN, not an address: call `address_autocomplete` (free) to narrow, then `address_resolve` to get one.

code.description: Lowercase postcode district ('e5') or an ONS/GSS code ('E09000012').
